ZAGGLE.d: Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited provides spend management solutions, employee benefits, and prepaid cards to corporate customers. It operates in the fintech and IT-enabled services sector.

ZEEL.d: Zee Entertainment Enterprises produces and broadcasts television entertainment channels and digital content. It serves mass consumer audiences globally with general entertainment and movies.

ZENSARTECH.d: Zensar Technologies provides information technology services, including digital engineering and cloud solutions, to global enterprise clients. It operates as a subsidiary of the RPG Group.

ZENTEC.d: Zen Technologies Limited designs, develops, and manufactures combat training simulators and anti-drone systems. Its primary customers are defense and security forces in India and international markets.

ZFCVINDIA.d: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India manufactures air braking systems, conventional controls, and related auto components. Its main customers are commercial vehicle manufacturers.

ZIMLAB.d: Zim Laboratories Limited develops and manufactures specialized pharmaceutical dosage forms and delivery systems. It serves global pharmaceutical companies on a B2B basis.

ZOTA.d: Zota Health Care manufactures and markets generic pharmaceutical formulations and ayurvedic products. Its main customers include retail pharmacies, hospitals, and distributors across domestic and international markets.

ZUARI.d: Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited manufactures and distributes chemical fertilizers, urea, and specialty nutrients for the agricultural sector. Its main customers are farmers across India.

ZUARIIND.d: Zuari Industries manufactures sugar and ethanol, and generates power through its green energy division. It caters to domestic and industrial markets, operating as a diversified business entity within the Adventz Group.

ZYDUSLIFE.d: Zydus Lifesciences Limited develops, manufactures, and markets generic pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and vaccines. It serves global healthcare markets with formulations across various therapeutic categories.

ZYDUSWELL.d: Zydus Wellness manufactures and markets consumer wellness brands, including Complan, Sugar Free, and Glucon-D. Its products are sold through retail channels to health-conscious consumers primarily in India.
